why: Kirti Joshi published arXiv preprints (through 2024-2026, with a Nov 2025 FAQ) claiming to complete a proof of the abc conjecture by combining his 'Arithmetic Teichmuller Spaces' work with Mochizuki's IUTT, addressing the Scholze-Stix gap; the mathematical community has not accepted this, and status is contested/unresolved rather than confirmed.

found.title: Construction of Arithmetic Teichmuller Spaces IV: Proof of the abc-conjecture
found.note: Kirti Joshi preprint claiming to complete a proof of the abc conjecture building on Mochizuki's IUTT; not community-accepted.

found.title: FAQ about the proof of the abc-conjecture
found.note: Joshi FAQ asserting objections to Mochizuki's IUTT are dismantled by his work; conditional on community acceptance, which has not occurred.

found.title: Final Report on the Mochizuki-Scholze-Stix Controversy
found.note: Report on the ongoing dispute over whether Mochizuki's (and now Joshi's) proof is valid.

found.title: The abc conjecture is true almost always
found.note: Partial/density result (almost all triples satisfy abc, with O(N^{2/3}) possible exceptions); not a resolution of the full conjecture.
